hunt.name: Threat Intelligence Lifecycle Detection
hunt.description: This hunt operationalizes Google Threat Intelligence (GTI) by following a phased intrusion lifecycle. It begins by identifying the vulnerable host population to scope the effort, then searches for early-stage signals including malicious DNS resolutions and binary execution matches. The second phase pivots to follow-on behaviors: connections to multi-hop proxy infrastructure, high-volume file modification activity typical of ransomware, and unauthorized resource hijacking. Two agents sequentially weigh the evidence to confirm if a beachhead has progressed to an impact-oriented intrusion.

config.content: SELECT device_uid, cve_uid, severity_id, title FROM hb_vulnerability_finding WHERE severity_id >= 4
config.description: Identify the initial target population by listing hosts with critical vulnerabilities (severity_id >= 4).
config.expected_signal: A list of vulnerable device UIDs. This defines the blast radius for exploitation-based initial access.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, query_hostname, time FROM hb_dns_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{malicious_domains}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(query_hostname) || ',') > 0 OR LOWER(query_hostname) LIKE '%.onion%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find resolutions for GTI-flagged domains or multi-hop proxy (.onion) addresses.
config.expected_signal: A hit indicates a host resolving infrastructure associated with phishing, C2, or multi-hop anonymity networks.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, COUNT(*) AS event_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_file_activity WHERE activity_id IN (1, 3, 4, 5) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) GROUP BY device_hostname, process_name HAVING event_count > 100
config.description: Identify processes performing high volumes of file modifications or deletions, which is characteristic of ransomware encryption.
config.expected_signal: A high event count from a process on a single host may indicate ransomware; compare against fleet prevalence to identify anomalies.
